knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Faulty equipment is isolated, taken out of use and reported. Using it, or taping it, puts the next person at risk.
Occupied rooms are rescheduled to an authorised time and the change is recorded. The team does not clean around people in the room.
A handover must let the next worker act without guessing, so it includes completed tasks, exceptions, faults, stock, keys and unresolved issues.

practicalCriteria: Plans a zone route (example: five zones) from a sample service specification, with exclusions and windows shown.
Performs a supervised occupied-site simulation with segregated tools, and keeps the public route open or signed.
Finds and records planted quality defects, isolates a simulated faulty item, and completes a shift handover with unresolved issues recorded.
passRule: Route planned from the specification, occupied-site controls applied, defects found and recorded, faulty item removed from use, and handover complete with unresolved issues. Observed by an assessor in a supervised simulation. A knowledge check result is not a practical pass.
evidenceRequired: Pre-start risk assessment and defect log
stopWorkCriteria: Electrical item with doubtful insulation used
Public access route blocked or hazardous equipment left in a walkway
Product with no SDS on the register used
Handover signed off with unresolved issues omitted
